shared.plotRule: All levels preserve the same eight beats, actions, consequences, opening continuity, and closing hook.
shared.audioRule: Generate the fewest coherent acts from one editorial master and derive every sentence and Mimic phrase at integer millisecond precision from that master.
shared.mimicSelectionRule: Select exactly 30 unique source sentences per Chapter and level. Each remains one learner-facing Mimic item.
shared.mimicChunkRule: Each Mimic sentence contains one or more exact contiguous chunks. Keep chunks to 2–12 words; all chunks rebuild that exact sentence in order.

foundation.sentenceGuidance: Mostly 6–12 words; one clear idea per sentence; concrete verbs and explicit subjects.
foundation.languageGuidance: Use high-frequency vocabulary, chronological connectors, direct cause and result, and dialogue that is easy to repeat.

core.sentenceGuidance: Mostly 8–16 words with natural variation and connected cause-and-reaction rhythm.
core.languageGuidance: Use contemporary natural narration, playable dialogue, emotional consequences, and useful spoken chunks.

studio.sentenceGuidance: Mix concise impact lines with controlled complex sentences; preserve speakability and performance rhythm.
studio.languageGuidance: Use richer description, subtext, tension, precise verbs, and varied connections without literary padding.
